svg.title: Odin III AST node record and stores
svg.desc: The 24-byte odin3_ast_node record (src/ast/ast.h, 2A spec AST-4..AST-8) and the node, child and payload tables for "assign y = a + 1;". Hand-drawn SVG; the paper includes fig_ast.pdf, converted from this file.
svg.text: odin3_ast_node: 24 bytes, one per node, in a pagevec (IDs from 1)
span in the child table (payload kinds: the payload ID)
child table: one vector of node IDs; absent slots are 0
